Batch 2 Forensic Discoveries

Building on our first serial pass, Batch 2 tackles 30 longstanding mystery recordings across four legendary series: The Lone Ranger (1940 and 1950 transcription discs), The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (Tom Conway / Nigel Bruce 1947 runs & John Gielgud / Ralph Richardson BBC classics), The Adventures of Sam Spade, and Box 13.

1. *The Lone Ranger* — 1940 & 1950 Master Discs Dated

Contemporaneous General Mills (Cheerios / Wheaties) on-air sponsor billboards and master WXYZ electrical transcription logs date these 13 broadcasts:

  • Original Filename: Box_13_The_Bitter_Bitten_NoDate.mp3
